llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The BucketStore in both Thanos and Mimir needs a new SyncWithCallback method that synchronizes block metadata and invokes a user-supplied callback for each successfully added block. In Thanos, this method should integrate with the existing BlockLifecycleCallback pattern and use metadata.Meta, while Mimir's implementation uses block.Meta and requires a parallel method on BucketStores for multi-tenant fan-out.

FILES:
- thanos/pkg/store/bucket.go — Primary BucketStore implementation; add SyncWithCallback method using metadata.Meta
- thanos/pkg/block/metadata/meta.go — Defines metadata.Meta type used in Thanos callback signature
- thanos/pkg/store/bucket_test.go — Unit tests need SyncWithCallback coverage
- thanos/pkg/store/bucket_e2e_test.go — E2E tests need SyncWithCallback coverage
- mimir/pkg/storegateway/bucket.go — Mimir's BucketStore fork; add SyncWithCallback method using block.Meta
- mimir/pkg/storegateway/bucket_stores.go — Multi-tenant wrapper; add SyncWithCallback to fan out across tenants
- mimir/pkg/storage/tsdb/block/meta.go — Defines block.Meta type used in Mimir callback signature
- mimir/pkg/storegateway/bucket_test.go — Unit tests need SyncWithCallback coverage
